name: Carpool Karaoke: The Series
description: Celebrity pairings ride along in a car together as they sing tunes from their personal playlists and surprise fans who don't expect to see big stars belting out tunes one lane over.

videos.title: James Corden & Will Smith
videos.overview: Between hilarious duets of Smith's biggest hits, Corden asks about his career and family ... plus, they crash a wedding.

videos.title: Alicia Keys & John Legend
videos.overview: The soul superstars harmonize on each other's hits, welcome surprise guests and serenade a laundromat.

videos.title: Billy Eichner & Metallica
videos.overview: It's a battle of the screamers as Eichner and Metallica sing the band's hits—and a classic from The Little Mermaid.

videos.title: Maisie Williams & Sophie Turner
videos.overview: The indomitable Game of Thrones sisters sing Bieber and Miley while showing off their best Ned Stark impressions.

videos.title: Seth MacFarlane & Ariana Grande
videos.overview: The musical theater aficionados belt out their favorite show tunes, and Seth shows off his horn skills.

videos.title: The Cyrus Family
videos.overview: Miley, her parents, and four of her siblings pile into one vehicle for a rowdy good time.

videos.title: Queen Latifah & Jada Pinkett Smith
videos.overview: Queen Latifah and Jada Pinkett Smith—with a cameo by their Girls Trip costars Regina Hall and Tiffany Haddish—hit L.A.

videos.title: John Cena & Shaquille O'Neal
videos.overview: The large-and-in-charge personalities compare their freestyle and free-throw skills in between tunes.

videos.title: Jeff Gordon & Michael Strahan
videos.overview: Strahan ribs Gordon about his many sponsorships and gets him to sing along to his shout-out in Nelly's “E.I.”

videos.title: Shakira & Trevor Noah
videos.overview: Shakira teaches Trevor how to shimmy—and yodel—while giving him a tour of Barcelona.

videos.title: Tracee Ellis Ross & Big Sean
videos.overview: Tracee unleashes her rap alter ego “T-Murda” to lay down a guest verse on Big Sean’s “Bounce Back.”

videos.title: Gwyneth Paltrow, Jessica Alba & will.i.am
videos.overview: These Planet of the Apps castmates reunite for an airport drive that turns into a full-on dance party.

videos.title: Sheryl Crow & Dierks Bentley
videos.overview: Sheryl and Dierks bring plenty of surprises to Nashville, even though people can’t spell their names.

videos.title: Tyrese Gibson & Ludacris
videos.overview: Things get quite fast and a bit furious when Tyrese and Luda face off in an obstacle course driving contest.

videos.title: Blake Shelton & Chelsea Handler
videos.overview: Country meets comedy as Shelton coaches an unfiltered Handler on the art of car-singing.

videos.title: Neil Patrick Harris & Tyler Perry
videos.overview: Amid sing-alongs to James Blunt and The B-52’s, Neil and Tyler decide to start their own magic act—presented by Tyler.

videos.title: Joe Jonas & Camila Cabello
videos.overview: After Joe quizzes Camila on Jonas Brothers trivia, the pair bond over missing their proms—and decide to change that.

videos.title: LINKIN PARK & Ken Jeong
videos.overview: Ken Jeong joins LINKIN PARK for sing-alongs to their biggest hits.

videos.title: LeBron James & James Corden
videos.overview: Corden tests the limits of LeBron’s trash-talking cool in between sing-alongs to Usher and Ice Cube classics.

videos.title: Jon Hamm, Ed Helms & Jeremy Renner
videos.overview: The leading men of Tag compare awkward fan stories between group covers of “Bohemian Rhapsody” and “I Want It That Way."

videos.title: Evan Rachel Wood & James Marsden
videos.overview: The Westworld stars trade their horses for wheels and perform “Loop,” a hilarious new version of “Shoop” rewritten for their characters.

videos.title: Jamie Foxx & Corinne Foxx
videos.overview: They may be stars, but this father-daughter pair clashes over car music like everyone else. For them, it’s The Charlie Daniels Band vs. Cardi B.

videos.title: “Weird Al” Yankovic & The Lonely Island
videos.overview: Andy, Jorma and Akiva fanboy all over their comedy hero while singing along to his funniest hits. Wait for the blooper reel.

videos.title: Wiz Khalifa & Bebe Rexha
videos.overview: After testing Bebe’s massive vocal range, Wiz decides to teach her to drive. Wanna guess which two colors his test rides come in?

videos.title: Megan Mullally & Nick Offerman
videos.overview: The Hollywood super-couple pays their love forward by setting up a dating game show in their backseat and crashing a wedding.

videos.title: WWE: Triple H, Stephanie McMahon & More
videos.overview: A single vehicle winds up playing host to a dozen of the WWE’s biggest (and we mean BIGGEST) stars on musical adventures.

videos.title: Tyra Banks & Lil Yachty
videos.overview: Equipped with a big gold buzzer to recognize a job well done, Tyra tests Yachty’s skills at runway walking, flirting, and duets.

videos.title: Quincy Jones & Rashida Jones
videos.overview: Rashida quizzes her legendary dad on working with icons like Sinatra and Michael Jackson—while they sing Q’s hits.

videos.title: Kendall Jenner & Hailey Bieber
videos.overview: The supermodel besties let us in on their secret handshake—and then subject their friendship to a revealing lie detector test.

videos.title: Jason Sudeikis & The Muppets
videos.overview: Jason takes the Electric Mayhem’s van for a spin while Kermit checks out the gang’s musical skills in a series of auditions.

videos.title: Gisele Bündchen & Boyz II Men
videos.overview: Gisele used Boyz II Men songs to help learn English. Now, she fulfills her dream of becoming their duet partner.

videos.title: Star Trek: Discovery Cast
videos.overview: Sonequa, Anthony, Doug, and Mary nerd out about their Trekker fanbase between singalongs to David Bowie, Ed Sheeran…and Rent.

videos.title: Thomas Middleditch & Ben Schwartz
videos.overview: This hilarious duo’s ride has everything: crime, time travel, a magic carpet ride, and one life beginning as another ends. Also, Dr. Drew!

videos.title: Shaun White, Tony Hawk & Kelly Slater
videos.overview: When they’re not swapping injury stories, this trio of extreme athletes tackle a new competitive sport: Eddie Vedder impressions.

videos.title: Snoop Dogg & Matthew McConaughey
videos.overview: Ever wondered where “alright, alright, alright” comes from? Wonder no more, because Matthew is ready to give Snoop the scoop.

videos.title: Kevin Durant & Travis Scott
videos.overview: Travis and KD reveal their guilty pleasures, debate Domino’s and Thanos’ superpowers, and go from “Super Freak” to “SICKO MODE.”

videos.title: Brie Larson & Samuel L. Jackson
videos.overview: Singing through the Marvel Universe.

videos.title: Michael Sheen & Matthew Rhys
videos.overview: The actors and longtime friends swap animal attack stories, face off in an accent competition, and celebrate fellow Welshman Tom Jones.

videos.title: Taron Egerton & Richard Madden
videos.overview: The Rocketman stars share some questionable London “facts” while belting along to Bowie, George Michael, and—of course—Elton John.

videos.title: Ben Platt & Sara Bareilles
videos.overview: The Broadway stars invent songs for neglected holidays, cram a concert into a teeny-tiny space, and belt out pitch-perfect covers.

videos.title: Darius Rucker & Anthony Anderson
videos.overview: Hootie sing-alongs take a competitive turn when Darius and Anthony set out to break a surprising Guinness world record.

videos.title: The Masked Singer Judges
videos.overview: Robin, Nicole and Ken take a break from evaluating masked celebrities and force everyday citizens to perform for them.

videos.title: Kesha & Whitney Cummings
videos.overview: A simple car ride becomes a turbulent musical collaboration between the singer and the comic. Will their love of robots and aliens unite them?

videos.title: Good Girls Cast
videos.overview: Retta invites Christina and Mae to treat themselves on a decked-out spa bus in between passionate sing-alongs to Hamilton and Heart.

videos.title: Jay Leno & Seal
videos.overview: Jay’s a hip-hop guy and Seal loves soul and standards, but when it comes to serenading couples, it has to be “Kiss From a Rose."

videos.title: Deschanel Sisters & Property Brothers
videos.overview: It’s a new kind of sibling rivalry when Zooey and Emily go head-to-head with Jonathan and Drew to portray one another in a musical spectacular.

videos.title: Fred Armisen & Weezer
videos.overview: The alt-rock icons take the funnyman on a trip from their first hits to covers of TLC and Toto—and swap some questionable memorabilia.

videos.title: WWE: Becky Lynch, Roman & More
videos.overview: A new batch of wrestling superstars cram themselves into our musical ride for a raucous celebration of one-hit wonders and goofy games.

videos.title: Stranger Things Cast
videos.overview: These multitalented kids swap Broadway origin stories and look for summer jobs between Panic! At the Disco and Stevie Nicks jams.

videos.title: Maya Rudolph & HAIM
videos.overview: The comedy icon and the hard-rocking sisters jam out to Madonna and Prince — and HAIM hits, of course — on a drive around Los Angeles.

videos.title: Keegan-Michael Key & Rob Gronkowski
videos.overview: When Gronk decides to try a career in music, Keegan trains with gruelling vocal warmups and a medley of timeless sports anthems.

videos.title: Patricia Arquette & David Arquette
videos.overview: The superstar siblings relive childhood battles and compare horror movie screams in between sing-alongs to Violent Femmes and Steppenwolf.

videos.title: The Sharks of Shark Tank
videos.overview: Mark, Robert, Daymond and Kevin take their minds off business by singing Taylor Swift, but before you know it, they're competing again.

videos.title: Simu Liu & Jessica Henwick
videos.overview: It's a Y2K bop bonanza for these action stars as Simu draws on his boy-band past for some Backstreet Boys—all leading to a nail-biting finale.

videos.title: Murray Bartlett, Alexandra Daddario & Sydney Sweeney
videos.overview: The White Lotus stars recall filming their smash show, share some hilarious self-taped auditions, and summon tears for the first Carpool Cry-Off.

videos.title: Anitta & Saweetie
videos.overview: Slaying their own fierce hits, the superstars compare real names, take over a convenience store, and do the very first Boat-pool Karaoke.

videos.title: Zooey Deschanel & Jonathan Scott
videos.overview: These lovebirds first met on the set of this very show. They recount the details of their romance while singing Johnny Cash and Wham! favorites.

videos.title: All Elite Wrestling
videos.overview: Two carfuls of wrestling dynamos hit the road in Minneapolis, playing Mind Meld and tearing through a songbook from Pat Benatar to DMX.

videos.title: The D'Amelio Family
videos.overview: Charli, Dixie, Heidi, and Marc reminisce about past family road trips and surprise a superfan between Whitney and Britney classics.

videos.title: Sandra Oh & Duran Duran
videos.overview: It's a dream come true for lifelong superfan Sandra when she meets her idols for the first time—and even performs with them.

videos.title: For All Mankind Cast
videos.overview: In space, no one can hear you scream—but can they hear you sing “Spice Up Your Life“? The cast of the Apple Original is determined to find out.

videos.title: Nikki Glaser & Wilco
videos.overview: The iconic Chicago band goes on an adventure with megafan Nikki, featuring a cameo by the great Mavis Staples and a Ferris Bueller homage

videos.title: Hillary Clinton, Chelsea Clinton & Amber Ruffin
videos.overview: Hillary and Chelsea turn to their gutsy pal Amber for support as they sing along to empowering anthems--with an assist from Vanessa Williams.

videos.title: The Bacon Brothers
videos.overview: This duo celebrate their longtime band by covering songs from other sibling acts—plus, Michael teases Kevin for his years of fashion fails.

videos.title: Method Man & Chris Redd
videos.overview: From Stevie Wonder to DMX—and even Nickelback—the rapper/actor and comic riff through their playlist and a round of Black Facts.

videos.title: Ciara & Russell Wilson
videos.overview: The power couple combine their passions as they sing along to Ciara's bangers and hit the football field for a climactic pass.

videos.title: Brian Cox & Alan Cumming
videos.overview: The Scottish actors and longtime friends try to remember all the movies they've been in while singing along to Bay City Rollers and The Crystals.

videos.title: The Afterparty Cast
videos.overview: Brace yourself for outrageous death scenes and twist endings from the cast of the Apple Original comedy, plus singalongs to Lit and Haddaway.

videos.title: Avril Lavigne & YUNGBLUD
videos.overview: The pop-punk firestarters compare Canadian and UK slang—and school suspension stories—while rocking The Cure and Shania Twain classics.

videos.title: Lea Michele & Darren Criss
videos.overview: It's the moment Gleeks everywhere have been waiting for: Lea and Darren reunite to belt out Broadway showstoppers...and also Meat Loaf?

videos.title: Cedric the Entertainer & Sheryl Lee Ralph
videos.overview: Cedric gives Sheryl advice on how to make her next awards speech even more iconic, plus they jam out to Luther Vandross and Donna Summer.

videos.title: Alanis Morissette & Cara Delevingne
videos.overview: Alanis superfan Cara gets to sing along to her hero's greatest hits—and then introduce Alanis to "WAP."

videos.title: Girls5eva Cast
videos.overview: The four surviving members of this hilarious fictitious girl group receive amazing real-time news while bopping to Dua Lipa and Lisa Loeb.

videos.title: Ghosts Cast
videos.overview: Which ghosts are the best? The cast of this hit comedy have a lively debate—and spotlight the freestyle skills of their own Utkarsh Ambudkar.

videos.title: Alison Brie & Danny Pudi
videos.overview: The Community alums celebrate co-star Donald Glover with a Childish Gambino singalong and reunite with Joel McHale for some Eurythmics.

awards: Won 5 Primetime Emmys. 10 wins & 7 nominations total
